problem_statement: Creative-Md-Arif/Ecommerce-website is a static fashion e-commerce storefront (the MOHAMMAD theme: HTML + CSS + Font Awesome, no build step) served directly from static files, with a header navbar (Home, Shop, Blog, About, Contact and a cart icon), a hero banner, a Shop page with a product-card grid, a product detail page, and a cart page. Add a genre-native Shop by category control to the shop grid: a chip bar mounted above the product grid (shop.html) with category chips (All, Shirts, Formal, Casual, Outerwear) and a live result readout 'Showing N of 16 . <Category>' over the grid of 16 product cards. Clicking a category chip must filter the product grid to that category AND recompute the readout (e.g. 'Showing 4 of 16 . Formal'). The same Shop by category bar appears as a compact teaser on the Home and About pages so category browsing stays continuous across the store. The chip row must be responsive (wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow), and the product grid must stay a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles, prices, and readable active-chip contrast. Keep the store's teal-accent design language, navbar, and footer intact.
required_content: The shop grid shows a 'Shop by category' chip bar with five category chips and a live 'Showing N of 16 . <Category>' readout above a grid of 16 product cards.
Clicking a category chip filters the product grid AND updates the readout; clicking Formal yields 'Showing 4 of 16 . Formal'.
The Shop by category bar is present on the Shop, Home, and About pages (cross-page continuity).
At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow; the product grid stays a tidy legible multi-column grid on desktop with readable active-chip contrast.
Each product card shows its brand, title, category tag, star rating, and price with its product image.
No new JavaScript console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured page.
design_constraints: Preserve the MOHAMMAD storefront design language: white background, teal (#088178) accent, header navbar with cart icon, and footer.
The Shop by category bar must ride above the product grid it controls (shop.html) and as a compact teaser on Home + About; do not make it a separate page or hero banner.
The category chip row must be responsive (wrap / flexible chips), not a fixed-width nowrap row that overflows the mobile viewport.

The product grid must be a tidy multi-column grid; cards must not shingle or overlap via negative margins, and card titles / prices / active-chip text must stay legible (no near-black-on-dark or near-white-on-near-white).
Clicking a chip must recompute the readout from the active category; a frozen/stale readout that never updates is a defect.
Only the Shop-by-category markup/stylesheet/script and its per-page presence change between legs; the shared navbar and footer stay the same.
state_constraints: desktop_shop captures the shop page at 1440px: the Shop by category bar renders five category chips in one tidy responsive row above a legible multi-column product grid, active chip readable, readout 'Showing 16 of 16 . All'.
mobile_shop captures the same page at 390px: the responsive chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow (a fixed-width nowrap chip row would push the document wider than the viewport).
desktop_home and desktop_about capture the Home and About pages, each showing the compact Shop by category teaser (cross-page continuity).
desktop_shop_formal captures the shop page after clicking the Formal chip: the grid filters to 4 products and the readout recomputes to 'Showing 4 of 16 . Formal'.
Source inspection confirms a static storefront; the Shop by category bar lives inline in shop.html, its layout in css/shf.css, and its behavior in js/shf.js.

change_completion: The shop grid shows the Shop by category bar with five category chips and a live 'Showing N of 16 . <Category>' readout above a 16-product grid.
Clicking the Formal chip filters the grid to 4 products and updates the readout to 'Showing 4 of 16 . Formal'.
The Shop by category bar appears on the Shop, Home, and About pages.
design_consistency: The bar keeps the store's white/teal palette, navbar, and footer.
The product grid is a tidy multi-column grid with legible card titles, prices, and readable active-chip contrast (no overlap, no dark-on-dark).
Desktop and tablet appearance of the bar and grid are preserved.
regression: The navbar, cart icon, product links, and footer remain functional and reachable.
No new console errors or failed network requests are introduced on any captured page.
responsive: At 390px the chip row wraps and the page has no horizontal overflow or clipped chips.
The product grid collapses cleanly on mobile without overlapping cards.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static fashion e-commerce storefront (Creative-Md-Arif/Ecommerce-website, MOHAMMAD theme). capability=Add a genre-native Shop by category filter over the product grid: category chips + a live 'Showing N of 16' readout + a filtered product grid, plus a compact teaser on Home and About. The three legs vary only in the Shop-by-category markup in shop.html, css/shf.css (chip-row responsiveness + product-grid layout), js/shf.js (filter wiring), and the per-page presence of the compact bar on index.html/about.html. Reference: responsive wrapping chip row, tidy legible multi-column grid, live readout, bar on all three pages. The shared navbar, footer, and product imagery are declared infrastructure, identical across all three legs. Served directly as static files; reference is runtime-clean (0 console errors, 0 failed requests) across all captured pages.
